words.definition: n. 郡（英）；县（美）

examples.en: The county built a new public library near the school.
examples.zh: 县政府在学校附近新建了一座公共图书馆。

examples.en: She grew up on a remote farm in a northern county.
examples.zh: 她在一个北方偏远的郡的农场长大。

words.usage: 英国的郡与美国的县均称 county，为州以下行政区划：county court（县法院）、county seat（县城）。辨析：country（国家）仅一字母之差，是完形经典陷阱。
words.mnemonic: count(伯爵)+y → 伯爵领地 → 郡，县；勿混 country

words.definition: adj. 月球的，月亮的；阴历的

examples.en: China's lunar probe brought back valuable soil samples.
examples.zh: 中国的月球探测器带回了宝贵的土壤样本。

examples.en: The festival is celebrated according to the lunar calendar.
examples.zh: 这个节日按照农历来庆祝。

words.usage: 只作定语：lunar calendar（农历）、lunar eclipse（月食）。反义词 solar 成对记忆：solar system（太阳系）、solar calendar（公历）为科技高频。
words.mnemonic: lun(月，=luna)+ar → 月的；谐音「露娜」月亮女神

words.definition: n. 好客，殷勤款待；接待服务

examples.en: We were deeply touched by the warm hospitality of our hosts.
examples.zh: 我们被主人的盛情款待深深感动。

examples.en: She has worked in the hospitality industry for a decade.
examples.zh: 她在酒店服务业工作了十年。

words.usage: 不可数名词，show hospitality to sb（热情招待某人）；the hospitality industry（酒店餐饮业）为固定说法。辨析：hostility（敌意）形近义反，为考研经典成对词。
collocations: show hospitality to 盛情款待
words.mnemonic: hospit(主人，客人)+ality → 待客之道 → 好客；反义 hostility

words.definition: v. 撕裂；扯开；n. 裂口；破洞

examples.en: She ripped the envelope open and began to read the letter.
examples.zh: 她撕开信封，开始读信。

examples.en: A rip in the canvas allowed rain to seep into the tent.
examples.zh: 帆布上的一个裂口让雨水渗进了帐篷。

words.usage: vt. 撕、扯，过去式 ripped 双写 p；rip sb off 敲诈；rip sth open/apart 撕开；名词指裂口；派生 rip-off n. 宰客；ripping adj. 猛烈的
words.mnemonic: rip 谐音「嗤啦」一声 → 布被撕开的裂帛声

words.definition: n. 括号；支架；档次；v. 把…归为一类

examples.en: Please put your answers in square brackets.
examples.zh: 请把答案写在方括号内。

examples.en: The number of families in the lowest income bracket rose sharply last year.
examples.zh: 处于最低收入档的家庭数量去年急剧上升。

words.usage: n. 常用复数 brackets 指方括号；an income bracket 收入档次；v. be bracketed with/together 与…归为一类；派生 bracketing n. 归类分级
collocations: bracket A with B 把A与B归为一类
words.mnemonic: brack（断开）+et 小 → 夹断两边的 小括号

words.definition: vt. 恐吓；威胁；使胆怯

examples.en: The company intimidated its employees into keeping silent about the fraud.
examples.zh: 公司恐吓员工，让他们对欺诈行为保持沉默。

examples.en: He was intimidated by the sheer size of the campus on his first day.
examples.zh: 第一天，校园之大让他心生怯意。

words.usage: 核心句型 intimidate sb into doing sth 恐吓某人做某事；be intimidated by 被…吓住；派生 intimidation n. 恐吓；intimidating adj. 令人胆怯的
collocations: intimidate sb into doing sth 恐吓某人做某事
words.mnemonic: in+timid（胆小）+ate → 使人变胆小 → 恐吓

words.definition: adj. 内在的；固有的；本质的

examples.en: Employees work harder when the job itself has intrinsic value.
examples.zh: 当工作本身具有内在价值时，员工会更加努力。

examples.en: The intrinsic worth of the antique coin far exceeds its face value.
examples.zh: 这枚古币的内在价值远超其面值。

words.usage: 常用 be intrinsic to sth 为…所固有；与 extrinsic 外在的相对；考研常考 intrinsic motivation 内在动机；派生 intrinsically adv. 本质上
collocations: be intrinsic to 为…所固有
words.mnemonic: intr（向内）+insic → 长在里面的 → 固有的

words.definition: n. 发动机；电动机；汽车；adj. 机动的；肌肉运动的

examples.en: The washing machine's motor burnt out during the spin cycle.
examples.zh: 洗衣机的电机在甩干时烧坏了。

examples.en: Fine motor skills develop gradually in early childhood.
examples.zh: 精细动作技能在幼儿期逐渐发展。

words.usage: 英式口语可指汽车；adj. 如 motor vehicle 机动车、motor nerves 运动神经；派生 motorist n. 驾车者；motorway n. 高速公路（英）；motoring n. 驾车兜风
words.mnemonic: mot 动+or 物 → 使物动的机器 → 发动机

words.definition: n. 一针；缝线；（肋部）剧痛；v. 缝；缝合

examples.en: The surgeon stitched up the wound with great care.
examples.zh: 外科医生小心翼翼地缝合了伤口。

examples.en: His jokes had the whole audience in stitches.
examples.zh: 他的笑话让全场观众笑得前仰后合。

words.usage: 习语 in stitches 捧腹大笑；a stitch in time saves nine 及时一针省九针；v. 过去式 stitched；drop a stitch 织漏一针；派生 stitching n. 针脚
collocations: stitch up a wound 缝合伤口
a stitch in time 及时一针
words.mnemonic: stick 刺→stitch 针刺穿布 → 一针一线

words.definition: n. 杆；棒；（钓）竿

examples.en: The old fisherman held his bamboo rod steady over the water.
examples.zh: 老渔翁把竹钓竿稳稳地悬在水面上。

examples.en: Spare the rod and spoil the child, as the old saying goes.
examples.zh: 老话说，孩子不打不成器。

words.usage: fishing rod 鱼竿、lightning rod 避雷针为固定搭配；谚语 spare the rod and spoil the child 不加管教惯坏孩子；rod 亦可喻指权力之杖
collocations: spare the rod 不加管教
words.mnemonic: rod 谐音「肉墩」→ 肉墩般的圆棒 → 杆棒

words.definition: n. 动机；目的；adj. 起动的；发动的

examples.en: The police could not establish a clear motive for the murder.
examples.zh: 警方无法查明这起凶杀案的明确动机。

examples.en: Profit was the sole motive behind the sudden decision.
examples.zh: 利润是这一突然决定背后的唯一动机。

words.usage: motive for (doing) sth 做…的动机；ulterior motive 别有用心；motive 指具体行为的动机，motivation 泛指积极性；派生 motivate v. 激励
collocations: motive for murder 谋杀动机
ulterior motive 别有用心的动机
words.mnemonic: mot 动+ive → 推动人行动之物 → 动机

words.definition: n. 密谋；阴谋；v. 激起…的兴趣；密谋

examples.en: The palace was a stage for political intrigue and betrayal.
examples.zh: 宫廷是政治阴谋与背叛的舞台。

examples.en: What intrigues the scientists is how the birds navigate at night.
examples.zh: 让科学家们着迷的是鸟类如何在夜间导航。

words.usage: 常用 be intrigued by 对…深感好奇；intrigue with sb against sb 与某人密谋反对；派生 intriguing adj. 引人入胜的
collocations: intrigue against the king 密谋反叛国王
words.mnemonic: in+trigue（诡计）→ 暗中使诡计 → 阴谋

words.definition: n. 猎犬；v. 纠缠；追逼

examples.en: Reporters hounded the actress wherever she went.
examples.zh: 无论女演员走到哪里，记者都对她穷追不舍。

examples.en: Debt collectors hounded him for months after he lost his job.
examples.zh: 他失业后，讨债人追逼了他好几个月。

words.usage: v. 多含贬义，hound sb for sth 为…纠缠某人；hound sb out of office 逼某人下台；习语 news hounds 消息灵通的记者；派生 hounding n. 骚扰纠缠
collocations: be hounded by reporters 被记者纠缠
hound sb out of office 逼人下台
hound sb for debts 为债务追逼某人
words.mnemonic: 猎犬盯住猎物 → hound 引申缠住不放

words.definition: n. 肺；呼吸器官

examples.en: Smoking damages the lungs and sharply raises the risk of cancer.
examples.zh: 吸烟损害肺部，并大幅提高患癌风险。

examples.en: The runner filled his lungs with the cold morning air.
examples.zh: 跑步者把清晨的冷空气深深吸入肺里。

words.usage: 常用复数 the lungs；lung cancer 肺癌；习语 at the top of one's lungs 用尽量大的声音喊；相关词 pulmonary adj. 肺的，为医学正式用语
collocations: at the top of one's lungs 大声喊叫
words.mnemonic: lung 谐音「浪」→ 呼吸时肺如波浪起伏

words.definition: adj. 敌对的；怀有敌意的；敌方的；（环境）恶劣的

examples.en: The proposal met a hostile reaction from local residents.
examples.zh: 该提案遭到当地居民的强烈反对。

examples.en: The company launched a hostile takeover bid for its smaller rival.
examples.zh: 该公司对其较小的竞争对手发起了敌意收购。

words.usage: be hostile to/towards 对…怀有敌意；hostile takeover 敌意收购为财经高频；派生 hostility n. 敌意，复数 hostilities 指战事
words.mnemonic: host（古义敌人）+ile → 视人为敌 → 敌对的

words.definition: adj. 被免除的；被豁免的；vt. 免除；豁免

examples.en: Students are exempt from paying the admission fee.
examples.zh: 学生免交门票费。

examples.en: The new law exempts small firms from certain reporting duties.
examples.zh: 新法律免除了小企业的部分报告义务。

words.usage: 核心句型 be exempt from sth 免于…；exempt sb from sth 免除某人义务、税费；派生 exemption n. 免除，如 tax exemption 免税；注意不说 exempt to

synonyms.note: v. 解除，搭配 free from

collocations: be exempt from tax 免税
exempt sb from military service 免除兵役
exempt from prosecution 免于起诉
words.mnemonic: ex 出+empt（拿）→ 把义务拿出去 → 豁免

words.definition: n. 柜台；计数器；adv. 相反地；v. 反驳；抵消

examples.en: The shop assistant wrapped the watch and handed it across the counter.
examples.zh: 店员包好手表，从柜台递了过来。

examples.en: The minister countered the criticism by citing official statistics.
examples.zh: 部长引用官方数据来反驳批评。

words.usage: over the counter 非处方；run counter to sth 与…背道而驰；counter an argument 反驳论点；派生 counteract v. 抵消
collocations: over the counter 非处方地
counter an argument 反驳论点
words.mnemonic: count 数→counter 计数器；柜台是数钱处

words.definition: adj. 强健的；坚固的；强劲的（经济、增长）

examples.en: The country enjoyed robust economic growth for a full decade.
examples.zh: 该国经济整整十年增长强劲。

examples.en: The old professor is still robust enough to climb mountains.
examples.zh: 老教授身体依然硬朗，还能爬山。

words.usage: 经济阅读高频：robust growth/demand 强劲增长、旺盛需求；a robust system 稳健体系，统计学中亦指稳健的；派生 robustness n. 稳健性；robustly adv. 强劲地
collocations: robust economy 有活力的经济
words.mnemonic: ro（肉）+bust（胸像）→ 肌肉饱满 → 强健

words.definition: n. 短途旅行；远足；（偏离常规的）游览

examples.en: The school organized an excursion to the natural history museum.
examples.zh: 学校组织了一次去自然历史博物馆的远足。

examples.en: Their weekend excursion to the coast cost far less than expected.
examples.zh: 他们周末的海边短途游花费远低于预期。

words.usage: 固定搭配 go on/make an excursion to 到…作短途游览；多指结伴、有组织的一日游，与 journey 长途、expedition 探险相区分；派生 excursionist n. 远足者
collocations: go on an excursion 去远足
words.mnemonic: ex 出+curs（跑）+ion → 跑出去走走 → 短途游

words.definition: v. 嗥叫；吼叫；哀号；n. 嗥叫声；怒吼

examples.en: Wolves howled at the full moon deep in the forest.
examples.zh: 狼群在森林深处对着满月嗥叫。

examples.en: The crowd let out a howl of protest when the goal was disallowed.
examples.zh: 进球被判无效时，人群发出愤怒的吼声。

words.usage: 习语 howl with laughter 放声大笑；a howl of protest 怒吼；派生 howler n. 明显的大错；howling adj. 嚎叫的
collocations: howl with laughter 放声大笑
howl in pain 痛得嚎叫
words.mnemonic: h+owl：猫头鹰的叫声 → 嗥叫
